digitization: Frozen PR101 pooled independent Gaussian widths remapped by physical system/layer, donor2 for added disks; pixels/short strips2D,long strips1D
material: PR104 role-transported effective map with homogeneous added disks; no fresh mapping
reconstruction: CKF over all seven tracker systems
truth_use: Independent GBTS training and scoring only; no truth track grouping or truth-derived reconstruction seeds

metrics.primary: All-generated primary-muon reconstruction efficiency versus signed eta and pT
metrics.conditional: Separate reconstructable denominator with exact hit and pixel-layer requirements retained
metrics.fake: Unmatched accepted candidates / all accepted candidates, fixed truth matching threshold
metrics.duplicate: Additional candidates matched to an already reconstructed primary / matched candidates
metrics.uncertainty: Binomial Wilson intervals; zero observed fakes carry a finite upper limit
metrics.residuals: Full residual/pull distributions for all bound parameters; truth-reco sign convention retained
